evals.prompt:
this chat is huge and getting slow. Here's the whole thing pasted below so you can see it. Give me something to paste into a new chat so we can continue.

--- pasted chat ---
ME: ok so im building a small booking site for my sister's yoga studio, Next.js 14 app router, deployed on Vercel, repo is yoga-book. need classes, a schedule page and online payment. budget is tiny
CLAUDE: Sounds good. For payments Stripe Checkout is the quickest route. Want me to scaffold the schedule page first?
ME: yes schedule first. use postgres on supabase for classes. classes have title, teacher, starts_at, capacity, price_sek
CLAUDE: Done. Table `classes` created, /schedule renders upcoming classes sorted by starts_at. Seed script is scripts/seed.ts.
ME: nice. the seed has 3 teachers, Maja Elin and Tove. btw Tove only teaches mornings so dont put her in evening slots
CLAUDE: Noted, seed updated so Tove only has slots before 12:00.
ME: now payments. lets go with Stripe Checkout like you said, I'll make the account
CLAUDE: Great. I've added /api/checkout creating a Checkout Session and a webhook at /api/stripe-webhook. Test mode works with card 4242.
ME: wait. talked to my sister's accountant. she says we'd have to handle Swedish VAT ourselves with Stripe and she does not want that. she suggested Paddle because they act as merchant of record and handle VAT. scrap Stripe, switch to Paddle
CLAUDE: Understood. Removed the Stripe routes and replaced them with a Paddle checkout overlay and a webhook at /api/paddle-webhook. Env vars are now PADDLE_API_KEY and PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Sandbox purchase works.
ME: great. one thing, the webhook should mark the booking as paid in the bookings table. also bookings must not exceed capacity
CLAUDE: Added bookings table (class_id, email, status). Webhook sets status=paid. Capacity check happens in a transaction before the checkout opens. I have not yet handled the case where payment fails after the seat is reserved, seats stay held forever.
ME: ok thats the next thing. also cancel emails, maybe resend.com. lets not decide yet
CLAUDE: Fine. Summary of state: schedule page done, Paddle checkout works in sandbox, webhook marks paid, capacity check done. Open: release held seats after 15 min if unpaid, cancellation emails, Paddle live-mode approval (needs business verification, my sister has to submit it), and the site has no styling yet. Please keep the default Tailwind setup, no UI library.
ME: and everything in Swedish for the UI texts but code and comments in English
--- end of pasted chat ---
evals.expected_output: Handoff mode, uses the handoff template, no interview. The handoff records the FINAL decision (Paddle as merchant of record, because of Swedish VAT) and does not present Stripe as the current choice (at most mentioned as rejected). Also carries the open problems (release held seats after 15 min, cancellation emails, Paddle live approval, styling) and the constraints (Tailwind only, Swedish UI text, English code).
